**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refresh the theme binding when fetching a dashboard**

If a dashboard is loaded with theme A, its theme is changed to B (or removed) in Superset, and the caller runs `dashboard.fetch()` before saving, the save restores A. The new `theme` → `theme_id` conversion runs only in `from_json`, whereas `ApiModelFactories.fetch()` in `resources/repository.py` copies declared fields directly and ignores the returned `theme` object. Consequently, fetching leaves the old `theme_id` in place and the next PUT overwrites the binding just read from the server. Apply the same conversion during refresh, including clearing stale binding/unbind state, so fetching and saving preserves the server's current theme.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L84-L87](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/ffdd2683f09471e0c7515025d351c987ecc36b32/AGENTS.md#L84-L87)
